contentBlocks.title: SASSA North West Province
contentBlocks.description: Provincial hub for North West beneficiaries: regional office contacts, collection across the platinum mining belt, mobile services for remote towns, and local FAQs.

contentBlocks.regionalOfficeAddress: 2nd Floor, Mega City Complex, Carrington Street, Mahikeng, 2745
contentBlocks.collectionInfo: North West beneficiaries collect at Shoprite, Boxer and Pick n Pay stores across the province. Mobile pay points serve remote towns and communities around the platinum mining belt, where pay-week queues run longest due to population density around Rustenburg and Brits.

contentBlocks.text: Full-service offices operate in Mahikeng, Rustenburg, Klerksdorp, Potchefstroom and Brits, handling applications, reviews, card replacements and appeals support. Smaller towns such as Vryburg, Taung and Zeerust are served by scheduled mobile units that bring application and enquiry services to them monthly.

Retail collection works at national chains throughout the province. In mining towns like Rustenburg and Brits, population density makes pay-week queues noticeably longer — collecting from day two after your pay date, or mid-month for non-urgent visits, saves hours.
Remote towns depend on mobile pay point schedules published each month. As everywhere, uncollected balances carry over indefinitely, so a missed visit never means lost money.

items: Staff speak English, Setswana and Afrikaans at all branches.
Avoid pay week in Rustenburg and Brits — queues are the province's longest.
Mobile units cover Vryburg, Taung and Zeerust on monthly schedules.
Mine workers earning below the threshold may still qualify for certain grants.

faqs.question: Where do I collect my grant in Rustenburg?
faqs.answer: At any Shoprite, Boxer or Pick n Pay in the Rustenburg CBD, or at the Rustenburg SASSA local office pay point.

faqs.question: Can mine workers apply for grants?
faqs.answer: If you earn below the means test threshold you may still qualify for grants like the Child Support Grant. Rustenburg and Brits offices handle many mining-community applications.

faqs.question: Is there an office in every town?
faqs.answer: No. Full-service offices sit in Mahikeng, Rustenburg, Klerksdorp, Potchefstroom and Brits; smaller towns are covered by scheduled mobile units.

faqs.question: Which languages are supported?
faqs.answer: English, Setswana and Afrikaans — application forms can be explained in Setswana at every branch.
